products.name: Freepik AI
products.note: Stock image AI generation; commercial licensing; EU-hosted; content moderation

reading.body:
Freepik sells AI-generated stock images under commercial licensing, with EU hosting and content moderation, according to its product listing.

The product is categorized as image and graphic design, not as model training or infrastructure. The listing names four attributes: stock image AI generation, commercial licensing, EU-hosted, and content moderation. That combination matters for AI because it shows a consumer-facing generative image service where legal and safety controls are part of the offer, not an afterthought.

The data contains no compute figures, no power demand, and no building or grid information, so it cannot support claims about infrastructure constraints. It also lists no cases, no MCP data, and no usage numbers, so it does not show scale, model choice, or energy footprint.
